title: ExternalReference
description: Entity-shape schema for a persisted scientific object. It is NOT a request DTO: do not bind a client-supplied body directly to it. The fields id, version, schema_ref, lifecycle_state, created_by, created_at and visibility_policy_id are server-authoritative (docs/23 §3, docs/12 §3).

created_by.description: Server-authoritative: the server derives this from the authenticated actor and the evaluated policy context. It MUST NOT be accepted from client input. Authorization is default-deny and evaluated per command against actor+org+project+object+action+policy context (docs/23 §3); visibility expansion requires explicit authorized human action with an audit event (docs/12 §3, docs/23 §4).

visibility_policy_id.description: Server-authoritative: the server derives this from the authenticated actor and the evaluated policy context. It MUST NOT be accepted from client input. Authorization is default-deny and evaluated per command against actor+org+project+object+action+policy context (docs/23 §3); visibility expansion requires explicit authorized human action with an audit event (docs/12 §3, docs/23 §4).

canonical_url.description: When the server dereferences this URL to build a snapshot (docs/19 §2), the fetch MUST go through the mandated SSRF guard and URL allow/deny strategy (docs/23 §7, threat scenario docs/54 #5) — this schema only constrains the data shape and is never sufficient validation on its own. Fetched content is untrusted data, never instructions (docs/23 §8).
